title: Memory Retrieval in Transformers: Insights from The Encoding Specificity Principle
relevance: Frames attention as cue-based retrieval and shows keyword-cue match drives content-addressable recall in a transformer; a direct AI instantiation of encoding specificity.
finding: Zeroing the attention key projections for cue keywords sharply reduces ROUGE-L retrieval while random-token perturbations barely change it.
example: A transformer recalls a stored fact only when the prompt keyword cues match those bound at encoding, and zeroing those keys collapses retrieval [arXiv:2601.20282].
